source_revision: Shopify Admin GraphQL 2026-10; stock-cohort-v1; questions-v9; query-cost-v1
identity_rule: Immutable shop account; keyed connection-scoped item/location/level UUIDs. Item cohort UUID includes fixed scan cutoff; stable level economic ID with a new snapshot observation per cutoff. A complete later item cohort retires omitted locations without synthetic stock movement.
coverage_rule: Item-scoped declared point at fixed cutoff with all required quantity timestamps no later than cutoff; never a global completeness claim. Current quantity values plus independent identity scope. Exact business/effective point required; source limitations disclose non-atomic scan and unavailable historical openings. Invalid or declined item scope remains insufficient_data.

retention.basis: No live store grant or merchant retention authorization is available. Synthetic evidence covers encrypted originals, monotone source/class retention, audited disposal, guarded older-backup reconciliation and interrupted key rotation. These local proofs do not establish provider permission, full operational acceptance or independent certification.

item_id.normalization: Connection-bound keyed UUID; same namespace as order line inventoryItem.id. No SKU matching.
item_id.missing_behavior: Missing/invalid item ID fails the page without accepting its population.

location_id.normalization: Connection-bound keyed UUID; duplicate locations reject the item.
location_id.missing_behavior: Missing location ID quarantines the item.

unit.rule: Shopify inventory integer count => piece; stock-cohort-v1
unit.normalization: Integer quantity strings; no conversion from product weight or unit-cost money.
unit.missing_behavior: Other units require a supplemental typed producer.

observed_at.rule: Fixed source_jobs.checkpoint.through, retained in original evidence and canonical occurred_at; stock-cohort-v1
observed_at.normalization: All quantity updatedAt and level/item updatedAt must be at or before this cutoff. Point snapshot only; non-atomic scan limitation retained.
observed_at.missing_behavior: Missing quantity timestamps or values after cutoff quarantine the item; no historical point is invented.

basis.normalization: Use provider available directly; do not subtract committed or reserved again.
basis.missing_behavior: Missing available or an unsupported basis blocks an availability answer.

physical.normalization: Exact nonnegative integer string; updatedAt is required. No inference from snapshot differences.
physical.missing_behavior: Any omitted, duplicate, negative or untimed quantity quarantines the item and emits stock.invalid_snapshot; no zero default.

event_rules.rule: One typed observation for each active level plus item cohort/coverage. Preserve exact provider states; Rust queries use provider_available and current cohort membership; no goods movement inferred.
No cause-of-adjustment event is emitted from current snapshot differences.
event_rules.unsupported_reason: InventoryLevel quantities and their update timestamps do not establish the cause, document or lifecycle of a physical goods movement.

synchronization.initial_import: All accessible items and all nested levels within explicit bounds; no updatedAt item cursor assumption. Retain original selected time/context choice and fixed cutoff.
synchronization.cursor: Opaque outer item endCursor in fenced durable checkpoint; nested level pages complete before atomic item commit. Reject missing/repeated nested cursor, changed header, oversized populations. Explicit requested-cost rejection reduces only connection pages without changing the fixed cursor; at most eight attempts under the original deadline.
synchronization.reconciliation: Full current enumeration; item cohort filters out locations omitted in a later successful item listing. Old journal facts remain immutable. No global absence inference for deleted items.
synchronization.deduplication: Stable connection/level/cutoff observation; replay the same fixed cohort without duplicate effects. Changed content at the same revision/cutoff is reviewed, not overwritten.
synchronization.freshness: Success, last new observation, reconciliation and current failure are separate. Permission loss stops jobs. Failed or quarantined scans never prove coverage.

local_standalone.schedule: One full item scan per incremental poll, default 120 seconds plus 0–10% jitter; reconciliation every six hours; independent background worker.
local_standalone.history_limit: Current item/location snapshots only; no historical opening or intermediate quantity events; exact point scope and up to 50000 items/248 locations per item.
local_standalone.authentication: Encrypted app token or permitted client credentials; strict myshopify.com outbound host; immutable shop identity; read_orders and read_inventory (or respective write grants); grants checked each page.
local_standalone.recovery: Durable per-page cursor and atomic item cohort; same fixed scan is idempotent; lease/reconnect fencing; bounded retry; original retained-input retry; journal reconstruction after restart.
local_standalone.limitations: No atomic cross-location read, source adjustment cause, global complete population, untracked-item availability or live-provider proof. Negative quantities remain unresolved.
local_standalone.reason: Outbound-only local pilot. Point observations can answer narrow queries with declared limitations; other scopes remain partial/unknown.

local_gateway.schedule: No gateway/server scheduling in the pilot.
local_gateway.history_limit: No history transport in this mode.
local_gateway.authentication: No public callback, gateway credential or public binding is provisioned.
local_gateway.recovery: No mode runtime to recover; use local_standalone.
local_gateway.limitations: Deferred by baseline-v14 local pilot scope.
local_gateway.reason: Explicit owner-approved P0–P4 scope excludes gateway and public-server implementation.

import_readiness.time_selection: Shared immutable timezone-aware 30-day/calendar/custom/from-now plans. Current snapshots only; selected history is not falsely certified.
import_readiness.historical_availability: Provider exposes current quantities with last-updated timestamps; no event history or historical opening implied.
import_readiness.open_and_related_records: Stock does not traverse the open-order stage. Item/location scan is its own population, not an order-reservation derivation.
import_readiness.opening_state: Declined opening excludes any level with older quantity states. Default consent permits present snapshots, not a historical opening balance.
import_readiness.progress_accounting: One logical item per cohort; committed/duplicate/skipped/quarantined and applied-cursor counts retained in PostgreSQL. No estimated total or percent.
import_readiness.readiness_rules: Only fully enumerated, valid item at the exact declared point can supply available values, with explicit non-atomic limitations. Missing quantities, basis, scope, identity or cutoff coverage block an answer.
import_readiness.health_rules: Per-page immutable account and inventory grant check, truthful successful-check/new-observation/reconciliation timestamps and unresolved-review health.
import_readiness.history_expansion: Append-only plan; adding the stock capability schedules independent polling/reconciliation. New jobs select the latest plan that includes their capability.
import_readiness.data_handling: No SKU, address, title or product description queried. Encrypted original evidence and minimal canonical fields; remaining required secret/retention operations are not certified by this mapping.
